content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for BJRMH Delhi Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BJRMH Delhi Junior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to appear for the interview on 01 September 2026. There is no separate last date for online application.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Junior Resident post is an MBBS degree from a recognized University/Institute.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies available for the Junior Resident post at Babu Jagjivan Ram Memorial Hospital.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Resident position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is as per Pay Matrix 10 of the 7th CPC, with a Basic Pay of Rs. 56100 and other admissible allowances per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the General category is 30 years, for SC/ST it is 35 years, and for OBC it is 33 years. Relaxation is available up to 40 years if fresh candidates are not available.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in-Interview on a merit basis, followed by medical fitness and verification of certificates.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for BJRMH Delhi Junior Resident recruitment being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Babu Jagjivan Ram Memorial Hospital, Jahangir Puri, Delhi - 110033.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates who have completed one year of Junior Residency apply?
faq.answer: No, candidates who have already completed one year of Junior Residency from any Government Hospital are not eligible to apply.
